formattedAddress: No. 30號, Section 2, Xinguang Rd, Wanxing Village, Wenshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 116

text.text:
After visiting my favorite panda and spending some time at the souvenir store, I needed a short break, so I stopped by the giant panda house café for a coffee and some sweets. The place has a cute and cozy atmosphere with lots of panda decorations, which makes it feel very cheerful. I ordered a hazelnut latte and a fruit tart, both nicely presented and perfect for a mid day rest. The hazelnut latte was smooth and fragrant, and the fruit tart was fresh with a good balance of sweetness.

The waitress was very friendly and kept encouraging me to sit by the window. From the window seats, you can look down directly into the panda enclosure and watch the pandas while enjoying your drink. It is such a fun and relaxing experience, especially after walking around the zoo for a while. A great spot to recharge and enjoy a unique view.

All the food was awesome!
We tried Chicken Ham Creamy Spaghetti, Mushrooms Pizza, Panda Pao Set, and NY Cheesecake (not too sweet, perfect!)

text.text:
Italian menu but panda scenery 😆
I would expect dumplings or Chinese cuisine, but pizza & pasta is also good.

Food was good, had Hawaii seafood pizza & Seafood pesto Spagetti.
The pizza was really good! It had shrimps, bacon & pineapples.
The pesto wasn't really pesto flavor, kinda like Spinat? But still tasty.

Drinks:
• Ice pineapple tea was awesome, very refreshing not too sweet, the tea base was good and it had pineapples bites.
• Iced cafe latte, needed more strong coffee. It was kinda watery.

Atmosphere:
Nice, we got the table right on the window with panda view!

We came around 2 PM when lunch time has ended. There was a wait around 10min. I assume at lunch time (12-1PM) it would be very crowded. Luckily we were late.
But the dessert were all sold out and some menu too.
After we finish our meal and went out, we saw some of the dessert has been restocked, looked good but we were short on time and moved on.

text.text:
An unexpected meal turns out to be amazing! 😋

If you chance upon this restaurant, I strongly recommend you order Takoyaki pizza. Its a MUST if you are a foodie like me. The seafood pizza, 'bao' or bun meal is excellent if you like sesame fillings.
